characterList.description: A scientist or educator performing a frog dissection, wearing a white coat and blue gloves; only the torso and arms are visible.
characterList.name: Dissecting person

content_metadata.description: A video showcasing the dissection of a frog, highlighting its various organs and structures.

qAndA.answer: 3 lobes; a right lobe, a left anterior, and a left posterior lobe.
qAndA.question: How many lobes does the liver have?
What is the triangle-shaped structure above the liver?
What is the spider web stuff on the heart?

qAndA.answer: The Dissecting person initially believes it to be a male, but after examining the reproductive organs they determine that it is a female frog.
qAndA.question: Is the frog male or female?

scenes.contextualRelevance: Educational dissection video for biology students

narrativeProgression.description: The Dissecting person begins by cutting open the frog and pulling the skin back.
The Dissecting person begins to point out the liver and the different sections of it.
The Dissecting person points out the heart and the peritoneum.
The Dissecting person points out the ventricle and the atrium of the heart.
The Dissecting person points out the conus arteriosis.
The Dissecting person points out the gallbladder.
The Dissecting person points out the stomach.
The Dissecting person points out a fat body.
The Dissecting person mentions that there are no eggs present and assumes that it is a male frog, but will check to see if it has testicles.
The Dissecting person points out the pyloric sphincter valve and the small intestines.
The Dissecting person points out the duodenum, jejunum, and ilium.
The Dissecting person points out the large intestines and cloaca.
The Dissecting person points out the spleen.
The Dissecting person looks for the kidneys and testicles.
The Dissecting person points out a kidney and mentions they do not see a testicle.
The Dissecting person points out the oviducts and bladder.
The Dissecting person points out the lungs.

scenes.title: Frog Dissection Introduction

climax.description: The climax occurs when the dissecting person examines the reproductive organs to determine the frog's gender.

storylines.description: This storyline features a detailed dissection of a frog, focusing on identifying and explaining various internal organs and their significance.
